name: Scrivent: Meeting Recorder
dev: Available Pretext - Desenvolvimento de Software Unipessoal Lda

ios.desc:
Record conversations and turn them into clear transcripts without sending audio to the cloud. Scrivent records on iPhone and iPad, transcribes on device, and labels speakers so you can follow who said what.

• See a live transcript while recording, then review a refined final transcript.
• Detect the spoken language automatically when a recording begins.
• Organize recordings in folders, rename speakers, and export transcripts.
• Keep a private access log on your device.

No account is required. Audio and transcripts remain on your device unless you choose to export them. Recordings and app data are protected with iOS file encryption.

Start free. A one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited recordings and full session length.
